_comment: FDC (sister project) packaging-vendor list for a one-off Probe42 pull. Every CIN was web-verified (Zaubacorp/Tofler/Tracxn/MCA aggregators) on 2026-10-13. The 'verified' flag drives the fetcher's pre-payment gate: Probe42's FREE datastatus endpoint returns only data-availability (no legal name), so a credit is spent only when (a) datastatus shows data exists AND (b) this CIN↔name link is web-'confirmed'/'aggregator'. The PAID comprehensive response's legal_name is then checked post-fetch and any mismatch is flagged (the paid file is kept, never discarded). Entries with cin:null could not be resolved to a registered company and are never called. This file is for FDC only — it does NOT touch mcAffeine's own data/clean/entities.json.

vendors.name: GEEP Industries (India) Private Limited
vendors.note: Confirmed on Zaubacorp/Tofler/Tracxn: 'GEEP INDUSTRIES (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED', RoC-Mumbai, inc. 15 Nov 2002, office in Wagle Estate, Thane; Active; Thanawala family directors. IndiaMART lists it as a manufacturer of bale ties, packing straps/clips & dry battery cells (packaging-relevant).
